description: This file contains automated unit tests for the UserAPI class within the OrangeHRM administrative API, specifically testing CRUD operations (getAll, getOne, create, update) for user-related API endpoints using data providers and mock services.

classes.name: UserAPITest
classes.description: Test suite for the UserAPI class focusing on admin API endpoints related to user management.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by truncating specific database tables before each test.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all users through the API endpoint using provided test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for testing the getAll method.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a single user by ID through the API endpoint.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for testing the getOne method.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new user via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the create method.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing user via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the update method.

methods.name: enableSocialMediaAuthPreHook
methods.description: Enables social media authentication provider for testing purposes by updating its status in the database.
